verdict.rationale: Smithery documents a Triggers feature. A consumer activates a trigger through Smithery, which proxies the subscribe call to the MCP server, and the server then POSTs events directly to the consumer instead of being polled. Trigger schemas are also included in the generated typed SDKs. Missing for 10: evidence of which or how many hosted servers actually implement triggers (support depends on each server author), details on consumer-side webhook delivery guarantees or retries since Smithery is not in the delivery path, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
